row: Phoenix College is the Flagship college of the Maricopa Community College District in Phoenix, Arizona. With over 150 degree and certificate programs, including two bachelor degree programs, Phoenix College serves approximately 17,000 students each year. We work hard to prepare you for whatever your next step is — university transfer, career training, and advancement, or lifelong learning.
